item.title: Follow cursor pages in listItems
item.brief: Update listItems(transport) to return every item in original order by requesting pages until next_cursor is null or absent. The first request must omit cursor; pass each later cursor back unchanged. Update client tests for multipage traversal, ordering, absent/null terminal cursor, and initial request. Update README documentation. Run `npm test` and ensure it passes. Commit the changes locally.

item.title: Implement cursor pagination for GET /items
item.brief: Implement GET /items cursor pagination per the shared contract. Validate limit and cursor; invalid values must return status 400 and JSON {"error":"..."}. Ensure stable id ordering and correct next_cursor behavior, including null on the last page. Add/update API tests for defaults, page traversal, ordering, invalid parameters and final-page behavior. Update README documentation. Run `python3 -m unittest` and ensure it passes. Commit the changes locally.
